verdict.rationale: Reducto is a document-processing API/platform that itself exposes an MCP server (docs-8, docs-24, reducto-probe-3, reducto-probe-rt-3) so that agentic clients like Claude, Cursor, etc. can call its parse/extract/split tools — it plays the tool-provider (server) role in the MCP ecosystem, not an agent that consumes other MCP servers' tools. The story as written (product acting as an MCP client that plugs in external tool servers) is the wrong axis for a document-API product of this kind; no evidence shows Reducto itself orchestrating third-party MCP tool servers.
